description: Some jobs, like the credentialed construction-safety jobs in Los Angeles, are open only to a worker whose credential a person has checked AND whom the site itself has authorized. This is how the site says so. You are the contractor that posted the job, or the payer the job names as its acceptor, and you sign that ONE worker wallet may be on your site for THIS job. FREE, a signed statement, no fee, no gas, no money moves. It holds for that wallet on that job alone, never for another job or another person, and you can withdraw it the same way (pass revoke true). The house, the worker and a stranger are refused here, and nothing is signed for them: the signer must be the wallet the job names. A job that needs a permit stays closed whatever you sign, and it does not check the worker's credential, which the worker records themselves. Never put a phone number, an email or an address in the note. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the authorizer wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_site_authorization within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

authorizerWallet.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet that posted the job, or the acceptor it names. Address only, never a private key.

note.description: Optional, up to 200 characters: one plain sentence for your own record. Never a phone number, an email or an address.

revoke.description: Pass true to withdraw this worker's authorization on this job. Leave out to give it.

workId.description: The packet id of the job the worker will do on your site.

workerWallet.description: The 0x… address of the one worker you are authorizing. The worker gives you this. Address only, never a private key.

name: prepare_site_authorization
title: Authorize a worker on your site (step 1 of 2)
